title: Sensory Systems: Vision and Hearing
summary: Eye structure (cornea to retina); photoreceptor cells; ear structure (outer, middle, inner); auditory pathway.
objectives: Describe eye structure and photoreceptor functions.
Describe ear structure and auditory pathway.
revision: Eye: cornea → iris → lens → retina (rods/cones) → optic nerve. Ear: outer → middle → inner (cochlea) → auditory nerve → cortex. Rods = low-light; Cones = colour/detail.
traps: Cones = colour vision; Rods = low-light vision.
Auditory pathway: outer → middle → inner ear → nerve → cortex.

notes.t: Sound travels from outer ear → middle ear → inner ear (cochlea) → auditory nerve → auditory cortex in the temporal lobe.
UGC NET frequently asks about eye and ear structure, photoreceptor functions (rods vs cones) and the auditory pathway sequence.

mnemonics.title: CILRO
mnemonics.text: C — Cornea, I — Iris, L — Lens, R — Retina, O — Optic nerve

flashcards.a: Rods = low-light; Cones = colour and detail.
